questions.title: Which U.S. state will have the highest reported cyclospora case count by July 16, 2026?
questions.background: Cyclospora is a parasite that causes intestinal illness. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) monitors reported infections across U.S. states.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The latest CDC state-level data publicly available on July 16, 2026, reporting the cumulative number of cyclospora infections reported during 2026 Resolution Date : 2026-07-16 Accepted Answer Format : String (name of the U.S. state)

questions.title: With which country will the United States record its largest trade deficit in May 2026?
questions.background: The United States publishes monthly trade data, including trade balances with its major trading partners.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve using the country-level trade balances in the initial May 2026 trade report from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau. Identify the individual country associated with the largest U.S. trade deficit, excluding regional groupings. Resolution Date : 2026-07-07 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: What principal criminal penalty will Hannah Dugan receive at her initial sentencing for obstructing a federal proceeding?
questions.background: A federal jury convicted Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan of obstructing a federal proceeding in December 2025. The case concerned her response to immigration agents seeking to arrest a defendant at her courthouse.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The federal court’s sentencing judgment or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the sentence announced in court. Resolution Conditions : Resolve when the federal district court first imposes a sentence for Dugan’s obstruction conviction. Identify the principal criminal penalty imposed at that sentencing. Subsequent appeals or resentencing do not change the answer. Accepted Answer Format : A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.

questions.title: Which company will hold the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign firm as of July 10, 2026?
questions.background: Alibaba's 2014 US initial public offering raised $25 billion, setting the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign company.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official issuer announcements and contemporaneous reporting by reputable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the company reported as holding the all-time record for the largest US initial public offering by a foreign company as of July 10, 2026. Compare offerings by proceeds raised, not company valuation. An offering whose pricing and share sales have been announced may qualify before exchange trading begins. Accepted Answer Format : The company's commonly used name.

questions.title: Whom will Donald Trump endorse in the 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee's Ninth Congressional District?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : as established by Trump's public statements or contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Date : ahead of the August 6, 2026 primary. Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the candidate's first and last name.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will be the first to impose a statewide moratorium on construction of large new hyperscale data centres?
questions.background: Hyperscale data centres are large facilities designed to provide computing and storage capacity at massive scale. Their development can place substantial demands on electricity grids and water supplies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Qualifying Event : Resolve to the first U.S. state to formally impose, by December 31, 2026, a statewide temporary moratorium on construction or permitting of large new hyperscale data centres. Proposed legislation, vetoed measures, and restrictions limited to individual municipalities do not qualify. Source of Truth : Official state-government announcements, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution occurs when the qualifying moratorium is publicly announced as imposed. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the state.

questions.title: Which company will be the world's most valuable publicly traded company by market capitalization on July 17, 2026?
questions.background: Market capitalization is the total market value of a company's outstanding shares.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the company identified as the world's most valuable by market capitalization in Al Jazeera's contemporaneous reporting on July 17, 2026. Resolution Date : 2026-07-17 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the company's commonly used name.

questions.title: Which country will the Trump administration target in its first invocation of Section 338 tariff powers by August 18, 2026?
questions.background: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes U.S. tariffs in response to discriminatory treatment of American commerce.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country whose exports are targeted by the Trump administration's first invocation of Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, announced on or before August 18, 2026. An announced tariff measure counts even if its effective date has not yet arrived. Use official U.S. announcements or contemporaneous reporting confirming the invocation. Resolution Date : 2026-08-18 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: Which Federal Reserve policymakers will vote for an interest-rate increase at the July 29, 2026 FOMC meeting?
questions.background: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets US monetary policy. Its policy announcements disclose members' votes and the policy preferences of dissenting voters.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Federal Reserve's official policy statement and voting record for the meeting concluding July 29, 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution : Identify every voting member whose recorded position favors increasing the federal funds target range relative to the range immediately before the meeting. Include those members whether an increase is adopted or they dissent in favor of one. Accepted Answer Format : All qualifying members' surnames, listed alphabetically and separated by commas.

questions.title: Which month of 2026 will have the highest ICE arrest total in the data publicly available by August 26, 2026?
questions.background: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) carries out arrests as part of federal immigration enforcement.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Use government data supplied by ICE, as reported by The Associated Press. Resolution Date : Resolve to the calendar month of 2026 with the largest arrest total among the months covered by the latest ICE monthly figures publicly available by August 26, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the month name only.

questions.title: Who will win the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Kansas in 2026?
questions.background: Kansas will hold a U.S. Senate election in November 2026, with party nominees selected in the August primary.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Results reported by Kansas election authorities or definitive election reporting from a major news organization. Resolution : Resolve to the winner of Kansas's Democratic U.S. Senate primary scheduled for August 4, 2026, once the outcome is unambiguously reported. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will win Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate?
questions.background: Michigan will elect a U.S. senator in November 2026. The Democratic primary will determine the party’s nominee for that election.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Results from Michigan election authorities or unambiguous reporting by major news organizations identifying the winner of Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate. Resolution Date : Resolve when the winner of the primary, scheduled for August 4, 2026, is publicly established. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate’s name.
